::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/orders"}
#docs
Invoices for one-time products: no subscription, at least one one-time line that is not a credit pack, and a status of posted, payment_due, not_paid or paid. Same paging, sort and filter grammar as the invoice list. `status` is what the list shows: `paid`, `due`, `refunded` or `partly_refunded`; `invoice_status` is the invoice's own status. `?customer=cus_a` scopes the list to one customer. A custom field of the customer filters as `cf_<api_name>`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of rows to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |
| `offset` | `string` | no | The previous page's next_offset — the same token as next_cursor under a second name. Pass one of offset or starting_after, not two different values. |
| `include_deleted` | `boolean` | no | Accepted; invoices are never deleted (a void keeps the row), so it changes nothing. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Free-text over invoice id / number / status / customer id, any name column (name, first/last, company), email |

| `dunning_status` | `object` | no | One of `in_progress`, `parked`, `succeeded`, `exhausted`, `stopped`. The old spelling `success` is still accepted as a deprecated alias and matches the same rows. |
| `ar_bucket` | `object` | no | Which rung of the receivables ageing ladder, derived from `due_date` against the time of the request rather than stored. The standard ladder's rungs are `Current` (not yet due, or no due date), `1-30 days`, `31-60 days`, `61-90 days`, `91-120 days`, `121-150 days`, `151-180 days`, `181-365 days`, `365+ days`. The rung names use an en dash, exactly as the receivables report prints them. The boundaries come from the NAME — `Current`, `<from>-<to> days` or `<from>+ days` — so a ladder built at another rung width (the report's `aging_interval`) drills through this same filter; a value that is not a rung at all is a 400 rather than an empty page. Ageing only: combine it with `status[in]=posted,payment_due,not_paid` and `written_off[is]=false` to match the report's own population. |

Comparisons accept decimals (`exchange_rate[gt]=95`), and the stored value is exact, so prefer `gt`/`lt`/`between` over `is` on a rate. |

| `customer` | `object` | no | Joins on `customers.public_id`. The bare `?customer=cus_…` scope above is cheaper (it filters the invoice's own FK) — prefer it for a single customer. |
| `customer_name` | `object` | no | Compares the customer's RESOLVED display name — `first_name last_name`, else `company`, else the legacy `name` — the same string `customer_name` is reported as, so `contains=priya raghunathan` matches a customer who has only the two structured columns. Not a column: `is_present=false` means no name of any kind (filter `customer_email` for the address a nameless row displays instead). |
| `customer_email` | `object` | no | Filter on `customer_email`. Send as `customer_email[<operator>]=<value>`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `order`. One of `order`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The invoice id. |
| `data.number` | `string` | The invoice number. |
| `data.customer` | `object` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.products` | `array of object` | The products on the one-time lines. Credit pack lines are not listed. |
| `data.total_minor` | `integer` | The invoice total. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The order's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.status` | `string` | `due` covers posted, payment_due and not_paid. One of `paid`, `due`, `refunded`, `partly_refunded`. |
| `data.invoice_status` | `string` | The invoice's own status. |
| `data.refunded_minor` | `integer` | Succeeded refunds on its payments. |
| `data.discount_minor` | `integer` | Discounts on the order's lines. |
| `data.tax_minor` | `integer` | Tax on the order. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the order was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.paid_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the order was paid (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.due_date` | `string · ISO-8601` | The order's due date. |
| `data.channel` | `string` | api, dashboard, system or import. |
| `data.payment_method` | `object` | The method of the payment that paid the order, if any. |
| `data.gateway` | `string` | Gateway of that payment. |
| `data.coupons` | `array of string` | Codes of the coupons that reduced the order. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque; pass as starting_after |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Filtered-set count; first page only |
